title: Kanban board
goal: Build a kanban board web app with three columns, in this order: "To do", "Doing" and "Done". Each column shows its name with the number of cards in it, as "To do (N)", "Doing (N)" and "Done (N)". Cards are stored on the server, each with a title and the column it is in. Above the board there is a text input with the placeholder "Card title" and a button labelled "Add card", which stores a new card in To do and clears the input. Each card shows its title and three buttons: "Move TITLE right" (not shown in Done), "Move TITLE left" (not shown in To do) and "Delete TITLE". Moving a card puts it in the next or previous column on the server; Delete removes the card from the server. The stored board is shown when the page loads. The board is kept when the server restarts.
